cases.title: User tries to assign key with valid user JWT token-negative-successful
cases.description: Ensure user without admin rights can't assign keys
cases.preconditions: User is logged in with its' valid user jwt

steps.action: Send request to /api/users/:userId/key to assign Key4 to User B
steps.expected_result: Request fails and no key is assigned, 403 forbidden

cases.title: User tries to assign key without JWT token-negative-successful
cases.description: Ensure un unauthenticated user can't assign keys

steps.action: Send request to /api/users/:userId/key to assign Key4 to User B
steps.expected_result: Request fails and no key is assigned, 401 unauthorized

cases.title: User tries to assign key with invalid/expired JWT token-negative-successful
cases.description: Ensure that requests with invalid/expired JWT token are rejected

steps.expected_result: Request fails and no key is assigned, 401 unauthorized

cases.title: User tries to assign key to themselves-negative-successful
cases.description: Ensure user can't assign key to themselves
cases.preconditions: User A is logged with valid user JWT

steps.action: User A sends request to ... to assign Key4 to themselves
steps.expected_result: Request fails and no key is assigned, 403 forbidden

cases.title: User tries to assign key to another user -negative-successful
cases.description: Ensure that a user can't assign a key to another user
cases.preconditions: User A is logged in with valid user JWT, user B exists

steps.action: user A sends request to /api/users/:userId/key to assign Key4 to User B
steps.expected_result: Request fails and no key is assigned, 403 forbidden

cases.title: User tries to reassign key to another user -negative-successful
cases.description: Ensure that a user can't reassign key from another user to themselves or someone else
cases.preconditions: User A is logged in with valid JWT token , user B exists and already has Key1
cases.postconditions: No key is reassigned; user B still has Key1

steps.action: Send request to /api/users/:userId/key to reassign Key1 to themselves or other user
steps.expected_result: Request fails, no reassignment is done, 403 forbidden

cases.title: User tries to assign non-existent key-negative-successful
cases.description: Ensure users can't manipulate payloads to assign fake keys
cases.preconditions: User is logged in with valid user JWT , Key100 does not exist

steps.action: User sends request to api/users/:userId/key to assign Key100, that does not exist, to themselves or another user
steps.expected_result: Request rejected and no assignment created, 403 forbidden

cases.title: User attempts to assign key to another user using another's user valid JWT token-negative-successful
cases.description: Ensure that a user can't impersonate another user by reusing their JWT token
cases.preconditions: User A is logged in, user B's valid token was leaked
cases.postconditions: Request is rejected and no key is assigned, 403 forbidden

steps.action: User A attempts to assign Key1 to themselves or another user while using user's B JWT token, send request to /api/users/:userId/key
steps.expected_result: Request fails and no key is assigned, 401 unauthorized
